# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: Although 一 is sometimes said to represent an outstretched finger, the phonetic evidence suggests the fundamental idea is that of its cognate 壹 (unity of contents). 一 may therefore be regarded as an abstract representation of unity, or fullness → *one*.
惟初太始，道立於一，造分天地，化成萬物。凡一之屬皆从一。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows the head of a nail driven straight into an object → raise a hammer and strike straight down on a nail. A seal inscription form depicts a nail at a right angle to a surface → T shape → *counter* (for city blocks, or blocks of tofu; or for the two sides of a page of text) (← shape of character) → *unit of length* (about 109 meters). *Fourth in a series* and *fourth calendar sign* are borrowed meanings.
夏時萬物皆丁實。象形。丁承丙，象人心。凡丁之屬皆从丁。
气欲舒出。纸上礙於一也。丂，古文以爲亏字，又以爲巧字。凡丂之屬皆从丂。
A vertical line cut by a horizontal one → slender objects produced by cutting. *Seven* is a borrowed meaning.
陽之正也。从一，微陰从中衺出也。凡七之屬皆从七。
高也。此古文上，指事也。凡丄之屬皆从丄。
底也。指事。
A variant form of the symbol 卍 (Sanskrit svastika, a good luck symbol), which was used in place of 萬. For meanings, see 萬.

The relevant seal inscription form combines 又 hand (suggesting measurement; compare 度) with 十# ten → a stick serving as a *measurement* of ten hand lengths ( 尺) (slightly over three meters) → *height* → *stature*; *length*.
十尺也。从又持十。
Three slender lines = *three*. In Chinese, "three" often suggests a group, or many; compare this sense in the cognate terms 參 and 森.
天地人之道也。从三數。凡三之屬皆从三。

A depiction of one line above another, suggesting the idea of rising *above* (contrast 下) → *up*; *upper*; *top* → *rise*; *raise*; *offer*. Other extended meanings include *ascent*; *readiness*; *completion*; *just after*; *go up*; *climb*; *enter*; *end*; *increase*; *improve*; *on*; *beyond*; *first* (half); *emperor*; *raise/bring up* (a matter); *record*; *upward* (bound); *go to the capital*; and *reach*.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is a depiction of one line below another, suggesting the idea of *under* (contrast 上) → *low*; *lower*; *below*; *down*; *subordinate*; *descend*. Extended meanings from "down" or "below" include *come/go down*; *fall*; *drop*; *hang* (down/from); *hand down*; *younger*; *have diarrhea*; *abort* (a fetus); *step/move back*; *withdraw*; *leave the capital*; *retire* and *surrender*. By further extension are *carry*, *remove* and *clear a table* (← take down from a table); *grate* (← grated shavings that fall below); *give* and *do someone the favor of *(← hand ← hand down); *obtain* (← be handed/given); and *latter half* (← bottom/lower of two halves).
下基也。薦物之丌。象形。凡丌之屬皆从丌。讀若箕同。
A depiction of a bulging, swollen bud (compare 芣). *Not* and *un-* are borrowed meanings (compare 拂 and 非).
鳥飛上翔不下來也。从一，一猶天也。象形。凡不之屬皆从不。
賜予也。一勺爲与。此与與同。
不見也。象壅蔽之形。凡丏之屬皆从丏。
A depiction of a small, curved boat → curve; bend. *Cow* (as the *second sign of the Chinese zodiac*) and *1 A.M. to 3 A.M.* are borrowed meanings.
紐也。十二月，萬物動，用事。象手之形。時加丑，亦舉手時也。凡丑之屬皆从丑。

醜.explanation: 丑 remains 丑 for earthly branch
醜.example: 丑年 → 丑年; 丑陋 → 醜陋
醜.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.

lexicalEvidence.methodology: Exact version-pinned phrase records, with independently identified dictionary, composed-example or literary evidence where needed; no native OpenCC execution was performed.

entries.text: A depiction of a pile created by the accumulation of small/slender objects → *furthermore*; *besides*; *also* (← addition).
薦也。从几，足有二橫，一其下地也。凡且之屬皆从且。

As per 不# (bulge) + a horizontal line → *great*; *large* (← bulging). 丕 was devised to recreate the original sense of 不 after 不 acquired its borrowed meanings, and the horizontal line functions simply to create a separate character.
大也。从一不聲。

The relevant seal inscription form shows the top half of 枼 as described in 葉 (thin, flat leaves piled upon each other), suggesting successive generations figuratively piled one atop the other → *one generation* → *era* → *successive*; *for generations*; *life*; *the world* (← successive generations that make up life/the world; compare 葉 as well as 祖).
三十年爲一丗。从卅而曳長之。亦取其聲也。
A depiction of the rounded cavity of a geologic basin, one surrounded by hills → *hill*; *mound*.
土之高也，非人所爲也。从北从一。一，地也，人居在丘南，故从北。中邦之居，在崐崘東南。一曰四方高，中央下爲丘。象形。凡丘之屬皆从丘。(今隷變作丘。)
A depiction of the legs of a table along with human legs spread from right to left. *Third in a series* and *third calendar sign* are borrowed meanings.
位南方，萬物成，炳然。陰气初起，陽气將虧。从一入冂。一者，陽也。丙承乙，象人肩。凡丙之屬皆从丙。

A simplification of a seal inscription character composed of 廾# pair of hands + an element combining 山 mountain and a squatting figure → *help* raise a person (compare 乘 and 登) out of danger etc. → *assist*; *adjutant*.
翊也。从廾从卩从山。山高，奉承之義。

並.example: 并且 → 並且; 合并 → 合併
並.evidenceScope: Normative column classification checked; examples reflect conventional usage, not an instruction for context-free substitution.

entries.text: A line, originally curved, that penetrates from top to bottom → *vertical penetration* such as of water emerging from a spring (compare 原/源) or of skewered objects (compare 串).
上下通也。引而上行讀若囟，引而下行讀若𨓆。凡丨之屬皆从丨。
相糾繚也。一曰瓜瓠結丩起。象形。凡丩之屬皆从丩。
The left-hand portion of the character 竹 bamboo, serving as an abbreviated form of 箇 *counter*.
A depiction of a *forked branch* → *forked/bifurcated object*. Compare 支.
The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows banners centered on the flagpole run through them → *center/middle* → *inside* → *throughout*; *including*; *the mean*.
内也。从口。丨，上下通。
A depiction of a *kneeling figure with arms extended*.
持也。象手有所丮據也。凡丮之屬皆从丮。讀若𢧢。
艸蔡也。象艸生之𢿱亂也。凡丯之屬皆从丯。讀若介。
A depiction of fruit-bearing, cone-shaped ears of grain → *abundant/luxuriant vegetation*.
艸盛𡴀𡴀也。从生，上下達也。

A depiction of two boards pierced by an elliptical connecting rod (compare 串 and 穿). Later, 丱 came to refer to a *children's hairstyle* in which two tufts or braids were run through and held in place by a hairpin.

丨# line that penetrates from top to bottom + what were originally two circular objects → *pierce* round objects (compare 丱 and 穿), which adhere closely in being strung together → *skewer*; *spit* (n.).
叢生艸也。象丵嶽相竝出也。凡丵之屬皆从丵。讀若浞。
A depiction of undulating *lamplight*. 丶 is also used as a shape indicator.
有所絕止，丶而識之也。凡丶之屬皆从丶。

The relevant seal inscription form is 人 person bending beneath a curved line# suggesting a cliff (compare 宛) → *round*; *circular*; *spherical* (← posture of the figure) → *roll up*; *make a ball of*; *wad up*. Also, *entire* (← complete ← round). *Suffix in the names of ships* is by confusion with the classical Japanese term まろ (maro), meaning "lineage."
圜，傾側而轉者。从反仄。凡丸之屬皆从丸。
The relevant seal inscription form shows a frame (compare 井) set into the earth, from which a reddish compound of mercury and sulfur bubbles up → *red*; *cinnabar*.
巴越之赤石也。象采丹井，一象丹形。凡丹之屬皆从丹。

丶# lamplight + a massive lamp stand → lamp stand giving off light (compare 灯). Conceptually, 主 represents a stationary object, leading to the meanings *master*, *owner* and *leader* (← person who remains in a certain place) → *main*; *principal* (← main person ← master; owner; leader). Also, *god* (← master).
鐙中火主也。从纹，象形。从丶，丶亦聲。

A variant of 井 well, the mark in the middle indicating water → *sound* made by an object striking the (water at the) bottom of a well. In Japan, 丼 came to be reinterpreted as a serving vessel filled with rice (どんぶり = a bowl of rice topped with vegetables, seafood and/or meat).
A character devised from the diagonal stroke of 必 (split). Compare 廴.
右戾也。象左引之形。凡丿之屬皆从丿。
左戾也。从反丿。讀與弗同。
流也。从反𠂆。讀若移。凡乁之屬皆从乁。
A depiction of vegetation cut in swaths → *cut grass*; *mow* → *manage*; *control*; *govern*. For the connection between cutting and control, compare 轄.
芟艸也。从丿从乀，相交。
A depiction of a supple ear clinging to the side of the head (compare 耳) or a fetus clinging in the womb (compare 身). *You*, *after all*, *that is (to say)* and *of* are all borrowed meanings.
曳詞之難也。象气之出難。凡𠄎之屬皆从𠄎。

The relevant seal inscription form shows an aged/long-lived person with a curved back (compare 老) + a line indicating a stick on which the person leans. *Long (time)* and *long duration* are associated meanings, likened to the longevity of an aged person.
以後灸之，象人兩脛後有距也。《周禮》曰：“久諸牆以觀其橈。”凡久之屬皆从久。
艸葉也。从垂穗，上貫一，下有根。象形。凡乇之屬皆从乇。

麽.explanation: The mainland 2013 appendix lists 麽 as the traditional counterpart for 么 in the me particle sense.
麽.unchangedSense: Independent use of 么 is not an instruction to replace every occurrence.
麽.usageCaveat: Not an unconditional replacement for 么 with other readings.
麽.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

麼.explanation: 麼 is an established regional traditional spelling for the me particle, especially in Taiwan/Hong Kong conventions. It is not the traditional-character glyph printed in the 2013 mainland appendix, which uses 麽.
麼.example: 什么 → 什麼 (regional traditional spelling)
麼.usageCaveat: Retained from Unihan; not listed as the traditional glyph for 么 in the 2013 mainland appendix.
麼.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.

麽.unchangedSense: Independent use of 么 is not an instruction to replace every occurrence.
麽.usageCaveat: Not an unconditional replacement for 么 with other readings.
麽.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

麼.explanation: 麼 is an established regional traditional spelling for the me particle, especially in Taiwan/Hong Kong conventions. It is not the traditional-character glyph printed in the 2013 mainland appendix, which uses 麽.
麼.example: 什么 → 什麼 (regional traditional spelling)
麼.usageCaveat: Retained from Unihan; not listed as the traditional glyph for 么 in the 2013 mainland appendix.

entries.text: A depiction of a foot/leg in forward motion → *go*; *reach*. *This* and *of* are borrowed meanings.
出也。象艸過屮，枝莖益大，有所之。一者，地也。凡之之屬皆从之。

A depiction of a sharp, ax-like implement chopping wood and creating piles of thin shavings (compare 創) → *sudden* (← swift chopping motion). *While*, *though*, *notwithstanding*, *both* and *all* are borrowed meanings.
止也，一曰亡也。从亾从一。
A depiction of breath running up through the lungs and producing an *exclamation* as it leaves the mouth → *calling* → *questioning*.
語之餘也。从兮，象聲上越揚之形也。
The relevant seal inscription form is the reverse image of 正 correct, suggesting a widespread lack of something that is correct, or required → *scarcity*; *meager*; *limited*; *lacking*; *exhausted*.
《春秋傳》曰：“反正爲乏。”

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a person atop a tree → help a person climb a tree (compare 丞) → *mount*; *ride* (← clamber atop) → *help someone get on* (a conveyance); *get into/take* (a bus/train etc.); → *give someone a lift*; *convey*. Also, *multiply* (← place atop), *take part* (← get on a vehicle with others) and *deceive* (compare English "take someone for a ride").

A representation of vapors rising (compare 气) and hitting a blocking element such as a ceiling, or the top of a container. *Second in a series* and *second calendar sign* are borrowed meanings. 乙 appears in dual-element characters such as 軋, 亂 and 札 in the form 乚.
象春艸木冤曲而出，陰气尚彊，其出乙乙也。與丨同意。乙承甲，象人頸。凡乙之屬皆从乙。
A depiction of a hand bumping up against something then bending or curving. *Nine* is a borrowed meaning.
陽之變也。象其屈曲究盡之形。凡九之屬皆从九。
Originally, the same character as 乙 (vapors rising and hitting a blocking element; compare 气). *Request* and *beg* are borrowed meanings (compare 匃).
A depiction of a long snake (compare 它). *To be* is a borrowed meaning. Conceptually, 也 suggests the idea "stretch."
女陰也。象形。
The relevant seal inscription form is 孚# (envelop/enclose) + 乙 here a shape indicator to suggest a breast → (mother's) *milk* enclosed in a *breast* → *feed* (a baby); *infantile*.
人及鳥生子曰乳，獸曰産。从孚从𠃉。𠃉者，玄鳥也。《明堂月令》：“玄鳥至之日，祠于高禖，以請子。”故乳从𠃉。請子必以𠃉至之日者，𠃉，春分來，秋分去，開生之候鳥，帝少昊司分之官也。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 乙 (rise) + an element# combining 日 sun/day and a pennant/banner → the sun likened to a flag that rises high in and adheres to the sky → *high and bright sky* → *dry* (← air/water that rises due to heat).
上出也。从乙，乙，物之達也；倝聲。

entries.text: A variant form of 龜 *tortoise*; *turtle*.

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows the left-hand element to have been two hands untangling a ball of threads by by pulling the threads up and down (compare 䜌 as described in 戀). Meanwhile, 乚 is a variant of 乙 (rise and hit a block). The combination of elements suggests a ball of tangled threads → *confusion*; *disorder* → *disturb*; *disarrange*; *rebel*; *riot*.
治也。从乙，乙，治之也；从𤔔。
鉤逆者謂之亅。象形。凡亅之屬皆从亅。读若橜。
A depiction of a long object such as a thread rolled back upon itself → *completion* (← roll up a lengthy object) → *comprehend* (← complete the process of understanding, and comprehend).
尦也。从子無臂。象形。凡了之屬皆从了。

瞭.explanation: In understanding/seeing-clearly contexts, 瞭 is an optional traditional spelling in Taiwan; Taiwan MOE accepts both 了解 and 瞭解. The grammatical particle 了 is unchanged.
瞭.example: 了解 → 了解 / 瞭解 (both accepted in Taiwan); 吃了 → 吃了 (Taiwan writing uses 吃; 喫了 is an older form seen in OpenCC's basic conversion)
瞭.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.
瞭.usageCaveat: Do not require 了解→瞭解 as a universal replacement. The initial 吃/喫 distinction is independent of the grammatical particle 了.

lexicalEvidence.methodology: Exact version-pinned phrase records, with independently identified dictionary, composed-example or literary evidence where needed; no native OpenCC execution was performed.

supplementarySources.finding: Defines the completed-action particle le and illustrates it in 吃了再走.

attestedTargets.qualification: 吃了 is supported in Taiwan usage; the base OpenCC phrase row spells the first character 喫. Both spellings retain particle 了.

qualification.recommendation: Say 了解 may also be written 瞭解 in Taiwan; do not imply mandatory replacement. Particle 了 remains 了 in 吃了. Cite Taiwan dictionary evidence separately from the base OpenCC 喫了 record.

entries.text: A depiction of a weaving shuttle that stretches threads straight out → *previous*; *beforehand* (← one ring of a shuttle moves forward to a new spot, so that the former position becomes one previously occupied. Conversely, from the perspective of the former spot, the new one appears to be in advance → beforehand). In Japan, 予 was also adopted as a Shinjitai (new character form) to replace 豫, according to which 予 also conveys the nuance of space sufficient to allow one to stretch and relax.
推予也。象相予之形。凡予之屬皆从予。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 又 hand/action indicator + an upright tube for holding slender, inscribed bamboo slats → an official raising a slender tube containing bamboo slats inscribed with records → *matter*; *affair*; *thing* (← matters recorded) → *job*; *work*; *serve*; *attend to* (← carry out official duties). Originally the same character as 史, but 事 and 史 came to bear divergent meanings (compare the same process in 句 and 局).
職也。从史，之省聲。
Parallel lines indicating *two* and suggesting an alignment of supple objects, along with the abstract sense of ongoing affinity.
地之數也。从偶一。凡二之屬皆从二。
步止也。从反彳。讀若畜。
A depiction of an object that stretches before bending into a U-shape. *Here*, *from*, *interrogative particle*, *go*, and *exclamation of lament* are borrowed meanings.
於也。象气之舒亏。从丂从一。一者，其气平之也。凡亏之屬皆从亏。(今變隸作于。)
A depiction of vapors rising from a heat source and adhering to walls or the ceiling → *mumble*; *say* (← vaporous/ambiguous utterances).

雲.explanation: 云 remains 云 when to say
雲.example: 人云亦云 → 人云亦云; 白云 → 白雲

entries.text: A depiction of two notched sticks that fit together in crossing → *mutual*.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows two crossing lines between two parallel lines. The meaning *five* may be connected with the idea that, when counting to ten on one hand, a person first counts to five, then crosses back the other way to reach ten.
五行也。从二，陰陽在天地閒交午也。凡五之屬皆从五。
A depiction of a deep, slender *well*. 丼 is a variant form of 井.
八家一井，象構韓形。•，𦉥之象也。古者伯益初作井。凡井之屬皆从井。
The relevant seal inscription form is 回# rotation + 二 align → circle about a neatly demarcated parcel of land → *cross over from one point to another*; *range*; *extend over*.
求亘也。从二从囘。囘，古文回，象亘回形。上下，所求物也。

Depiction of the moon crossing the evening sky from end to end → *cross over*; *extend/go/run all the way across/through*; *range* (over/about). Some dictionaries list 亙 as a variant form of 亘, but they are separate characters.
As per 此# (line up irregularly) and as per 二 (align) → align objects irregularly, leaving *a bit* of space between them → *a little*; *few*.
語辭也。見《楚辭》。从此从二。其義未詳。
A depiction of a square or rectangular foundation, *subordinate* to and pressured by the structure that fills it (compare 虛) → *sub*. *Asia* is via the phonetic construction 亞細亞.
醜也。象人局背之形。賈侍中說：以爲次弟也。凡亞之屬皆从亞。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a person, stretched to full height, standing between two lines. A bronzeware inscription form adds an element combining 口 mouth and 攴 action indicator → speak and act with the body in a state of tension from head to toe → *hasten* (← tense action) → *urgent*; *sudden* (← urgent/sudden condition causing one to hasten). A seal inscription form replaces 攴 with 又 hand/action indicator.
敏疾也。从人从口，从又从二。二，天地也。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 人 person + a long vertical line# behind which the person is (partially) concealed (compare 毋). The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows 人 person hidden by an L-shaped object → be partially obscured and dimly visible, or fully obscured and non-existent → *perish*; *fall*; *die*; *dead*; *flee*.

The relevant seal inscription form combines an abbreviated form of 大 stand outstretched + two vertical lines# indicating an elongated neck → raise one's head, stretching the throat → *raise* (the head upright); *proud*; *arrogant*; *high*.
人頸也。从大省，象頸脈形。凡亢之屬皆从亢。
籒文亣，改古文。亦象人形。凡亣之屬皆从亣。
A depiction of a standing figure with legs twisted or crossed → *cross*; *intersect*; *exchange*; *come and go* → *mix*; *blend*; *mingle*; *keep company with*; *associate with*; *converse*.
交脛也。从大，象交形。凡交之屬皆从交。
A depiction of a pig/boar stretched taut for slaughter on a frame. *Boar* (as the *twelfth sign of the Chinese zodiac*), *twelfth* and *9 P.M. to 11 P.M.* are borrowed meanings.
荄也。十月，微陽起，接盛陰。从二，二，古文上字。一人男，一人女也。从乙，象褢子咳咳之形。《春秋傳》曰：“亥有二首六身。”凡亥之屬皆从亥。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 大 stand outstretched + two marks indicating the two sides of the body → slender line of people standing outstretched → *also*; *again* (← one person after another); *armpit* (← sides of the body). Compare 胳 and 脇.
人之臂亦也。从大，象兩亦之形。凡亦之屬皆从亦。

產.explanation: Common traditional-script shape for “produce; property; products”; the 2013 mainland appendix prints 産 instead of 產 in its traditional column.
產.usageCaveat: A regional character-form distinction, not a separate sense of “produce”.
產.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix row directly checked for classification; lexical equivalence is not a context-free replacement.

産.explanation: Traditional-column form printed for 产 in the 2013 mainland standard; visually differs from the more familiar 產 used in some traditional-writing regions.
産.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix row directly checked for classification; lexical equivalence is not a context-free replacement.

entries.text: Originally the same character as 享 (one of a pair of gates positioned at opposite ends of an enclosure) → *smooth passage* (← unhindered passage between gates).

A depiction of one of a pair of gates positioned at opposite ends of an enclosure → *entertain guests*; *enjoy* (← entertainment taking place in such a structure ) → *receive* (entertainment/a privilege etc.) (← be the recipient of entertainment).

A depiction of one of a pair of expansive structures on high ground (compare 高) → *high hill* → *metropolis*; *capital* (← large settlement in sunny/bright heights safe from dangers such as floods or surprise attacks).
人所爲絕高丘也。从高省，| 象高形。凡京之屬皆从京。
As per 丁# (straight) + an abbreviated form of 高 tall/high → object that stands straight and tall → *pavilion*; *arbor*; *watchtower*; *restaurant*.
民所安定也。亭有樓，从高省，丁聲。

Abbreviated form# of 諒 clear (words) + 儿: *clear*. Here, 儿 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying a meaning that dropped from the original one. *Help* is a borrowed meaning.
獻也。从高省，曰象進孰物形。《孝經》曰：“祭則鬼亯之。”凡亯之屬皆从亯。
京兆杜陵亭也。从高省，乇聲。

As per 旦# (long and flat) + a granary (compare the top element of 稟) → the long and flat foundation of a storehouse → *thick* (← thick foundation). *True*, *truly* and *selfish/self-indulgent* are borrowed meanings.
多穀也。从㐭旦聲。

A depiction of a standing *person* reaching toward another, suggesting people in mutable interaction → *human* (being). Compare 仁. In dual-element characters, 人 nearly always appears on the left in the form 亻. In many such characters ( 價 儗 仰 儆 偃 儀 etc.), 人 suggests human agency, but there are others in which 人 has no semantic function at all. In these cases ( 伎 優 供 佑 傾 佹 etc.), 人 is used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
天地之性最貴者也。此籒文。象臂脛之形。凡人之屬皆从人。
三合也。从入、一，象三合之形。凡亼之屬皆从亼。讀若集。
逃也。从入从𠃊。凡亾之屬皆从亾。
十# ten + 人 person → *unit/group of ten* soldiers or other persons → *ten*; *a number of objects* → ordinary *utensil*.
相什保也。从人、十。
As per 人# (people in mutable interaction) + 二 two → two individuals in mutable interaction → *humanity*; *benevolence*; *virtue*.
親也。从人从二。
As per 力# (ripples) + 人 person → supernumerary (likened to ripples of a main force) → (numerical) *remainder*. In Japan, 仂 sometimes serves as an abbreviated form of 働 *work*.

厂 here an abbreviated form# of 厝 (engrave) + 人 person (→ human agency) → angle a knife in engraving → *incline toward*; *lean*; *oblique*. Also, *faint* (adj.) (← obliquely visible ← oblique angle ← lean). *Shabby* and *base* are borrowed meanings.
側傾也。从人在厂下。
卜 here a variant form of 菐# as described in 僕 (servant falling prostrate) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *fall*; *lie prostrate*.
頓也。从人卜聲。

As per 九# (bump up against and bend/curve) + 人 person → *enemy* (with whom one comes to grips in battle) → *rival*; *adversary*. Also, *hatred* and *grudge*, as well as *revenge* (← take revenge against one's enemy).
讎也。从人九聲。
A depiction of one object contained and concealed within another. It is likely the concealing object was originally a mouth (compare 含 and 吟, as well as 甘 and 音). *Now* is a borrowed meaning.
是時也。从亼从绁。绁，古文及。
𠆢 a variant form of 人 person + an element# indicating two sides → person intervening to reduce/eliminate distance between separate parties → *intervene*; *mediate*. *Shellfish* is a borrowed meaning.
畫也。从八从人。人各有介。
凍也。象水凝之形。凡仌之屬皆从仌。
As per 乃# (soft and clingy) + 人 person (→ human agency) → (cause to) *cling/stick to* → *add to* → *furthermore*; *not only that*; *according to*; *in consequence*; *yet*; *still*.
因也。从人乃聲。
相聽也。从二人。凡从之屬皆从从。
子# child/offspring + 人 person (for emphasis/clarification) → *offspring* → *small*; *detail*. Also, *young animal*.
克也。从人子聲。
As per 士# (erect) + 人 person → servant standing erect in waiting upon a person of high rank (compare 寺 and 侍) → *official*; *serve*; *work*; *do*.
學也。从人从士。
A variant form of 佗, and thus the meanings *another* person → *other*; *separate*.
As per 丈# (a stick) + 人 person (→ human agency) → wield a *stick* in battle → *weapon*. Also, *lean/rely/depend on* (← stick that offers support in walking).

An abbreviated form# of 尌 as described in 樹 (set/stand in place) + 人 person (→ human agency) → set/stand in place or spread over by attaching → *attach*; *be attached*. Extended meanings include *apply*, *per*, *hand something to*, *entrust*, *deposit*, *set*, *bill* and *credit*.
與也。从寸持物對人。

An earlier form of 仙 is 僊, which is the right-hand element# as described in 遷 (soul departing from the body) + 人 person → *wizard* or *hermit* attaining transformation via separation of soul and body. In 仙, this element is replaced by the cognate 山.
人在山上。从人从山。
大腹也。从人工聲。讀若紅。
完也。从入从工。
伸臂一尋，八尺。从人刃聲。
千# one thousand + 人 person → *leader of a thousand-man group*; *one thousand*. Compare 佰.
As per 乞# (rise and hit a blocking element) + 人 person → person who overcomes obstacles → *brave*; *gallant*. *Boat cutting through choppy waves* is a borrowed meaning.
勇壯也。从人气聲。《周書》曰：“㐹㐹勇夫。”
約也。从人勺聲。

As per 弋# (stake) + 人 person → rotate in keeping watch at a post marked by stakes → *substitute* (for); *alternate*; *take the place* (of); *replace*; *exchange* → *generation* (← one generation replacing the one that preceded it) → *price*; *money*; *materials* (← money exchanged for goods).
更也。从人弋聲。

An abbreviated form# of 今 (contain in the mouth) + 卩 kneeling figure → kneeling figure listening carefully to a long sequence of commands issuing from the mouth of a ruler → *command*; *order*; *rule*; *leader*.
發號也。从亼、卪。
Originally, an abbreviated form# of 台 (plow furrows) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *use* a plow to plow furrows → *with*; *by*; *from* (← create furrows with/by means of a plow).

卬# look up at + 人 person (for emphasis/clarification) → *look up at/to*; *respect*; *revere* → *depend on*; *another person's commands/wishes* → *take* (poison/medicine) (at another person's command).
舉也。从人从卬。
中# center/middle + 人 person → person acting as an *intermediary* → *matchmaker*; *go-between*; *personal relations* → *fellowship*.
中也。从人从中，中亦聲。
別也。从人比聲。《詩》曰：“有女仳離。”
牛 cow + 人# person → person sorting the meat and bones of a dismembered cow carcass (compare 解) → *item*; *case* (← sort through one by one).
分也。从人从牛。牛大物，故可分。
善也。从人介聲。《詩》曰：“价人惟藩。”

As per 壬# (encompass) + 人 person (→ human agency) → encompass/bear *responsibility* → *duty* → *undertake* (← undertake a duty/responsibility) → *entrust*; *leave* (up to another) (← entrust/leave up to another a duty or responsibility) → *leave to chance*; *endure* (← endure a duty).
符也。从人壬聲。
分# portion + 人 person (→ human agency) → *portion* out. *Harmony between the inner and outer person* is via reinterpretation, in the sense of contentment with one's allotted portion in life.
文質僣也。从人分聲。《論語》曰：“文質份份。”
As per 方# (spread right and left, or in all directions) + 人 person → person producing imitations and causing them to spread by distributing them → *imitate*. *Wander* is a borrowed meaning via 倣.
相似也。从人方聲。
